text:
Zoe: Morning crew :wave: starting a short thread to lock the SI onboarding surge readiness for the Nov wave. Main asks: final BOM variation per region, mentor swap pool rules, embargo matrix for joint announcements, and the verification ledger for badges. Need all constraints by Tue EOD.

Ethan: Quick clarifying Q  what is the mentor swap pool?

Zoe: Mentor swap pool = a small standby list of certified mentors who can be swapped into cohorts at short notice (24-48h). We need rules: eligibility (cert within 90 days), time-zone overlap, and shipping availability.

Maya: For BOMs: propose base kit + optional region bundles. Base kit: RDW-SI-BASE (compute tray, USB image, quickstart). Region bundles: APAC -> add IEC adapters + surge power harness; EU -> EU adapter + EU power cord. Mark ECCN 5D002 on all Intl manifests.

Priya: Marketplace/PR: create an embargo matrix column per partner: Standard (no review), Review7 (7 days pre-review), LegalHold (legal eyeballs required). Partners under LegalHold must get drafts 10 days early. Share partner list and I'll flag.

Aaron: Ops notes: carrier prefs: DHL APAC, UPS EU/NA; FedEx for urgent LATAM. Return label included. Pallet lead time: 3 business days for single-unit crates, 5 for pallets. For swap pool, keep 2 kits pre-staged in US & EU.

vendors-bot: [inventory] staged_kits: US=2, EU=2, APAC=1  restock ETA 2026-11-05.

Ethan: Certification tweak proposal: issue provisional digital badge on MC pass; final badge after either kit scan or screencast verification. Add 10% manual spot-check, and a random audit of 5% within 30 days. Also embed a short verification JSON blob with badge metadata (ID, issue_ts, verifier).

Zoe: Note: keep verification metadata within our retention policy (90 days) unless partners request longer. Legal: please confirm.

Priya: Legal confirms 90-day default retention. Exceptions need written partner consent. Also, for any partner-marketed quotes, route drafts to legal@redwood at least 7 days prior unless the partner is in the LegalHold bucket (10 days).

Maya: For the mentor swap pool we should require mentors to have completed the "train-the-trainer" dry-run in the last 60 days and have no open incident support tickets. That reduces risk during swaps.

Aaron: Logistics: I'll reserve 2 kits in US/EU and tag them as SWAP-HOLD. Shipping manifest flags: SWAP-HOLD, PROVISIONAL-BADGE, FRAGILE. Need final addresses by Nov 1 to meet Nov 8 ship date.

Ethan: Small tech snippet for quickstart card to reduce first-touch ops tickets:

```bash
# mentor quickstart (minimal)
redwoodctl kit init --id $KIT_ID --role mentor --ssh-key ~/.ssh/id_rsa
redwoodctl kit status --wait
# if network fails: sudo rdw-network-fix
```

Zoe: Marketing wants partner one-liners and logo consent by Oct 28 for the Nov 12 announce. Priya: can you publish an embargo matrix template we can fill?

Priya: Will post a Google sheet with columns: partner, logo_consent(Y/N), embargo_type(Standard/Review7/LegalHold), quote_approved(Y/N). Link coming to this thread.

vendors-bot: [task] print_labels job queued (job_id=print-3847)  estimated run: 2026-11-03.

Aaron: Blocker: one LATAM partner requires 110V-only adapter and local import licence copy. Flagging now — need partner to provide licence PDF by Oct 25.

Maya: We should also update the marketplace feature flag name for this wave to `si_onboard_surge_v1` and hand the gate to marketplace at T-48h pre-announce for partners in Standard/Review7. Priya will handle partner gating.

Ethan: One more ask: include a line in the kit quickstart with the checksum for the USB image and a small troubleshooting QR that links to a short 2-min bringup screencast. That cut tickets last time.

Zoe: Action items:
- Aaron: reserve swap kits US/EU + manifest flags (due Oct 30).
- Priya: publish embargo matrix sheet + collect partner consent (due Oct 28).
- Maya: push `si_onboard_surge_v1` flag to marketplace team (due Nov 8).
- Ethan: record 2-min bringup screencast + produce quickstart checksum (due Oct 27).
- Legal: confirm retention & exceptions (due Oct 26).

Priya: I'll post the sheet and ping partners with the consent request.

Maya: Acknowledged. If anyone has constraints (power, customs, logo restrictions), drop them here so ops can track.

Aaron: ack. Reserving SWAP-HOLD kits now.

Zoe: Thanks all  closing in 24hrs unless blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
